title: Counterfactual Safety Probing: Does Adding Benign Context Flip Refusals?

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Over-refusal and context-sensitivity are actively studied. OR-Bench (ICML 2025) is the first large-scale over-refusal benchmark with 80K prompts, showing strong correlation (rho=0.878) between safety and over-refusal. The Exaggerated Safety Benchmark (XSB) and Multi-turn Scenario-based Exaggerated Safety Benchmark (MS-XSB) systematically evaluate refusal calibration in context-rich dialog. 'Beyond Over-Refusal' (arxiv 2510.08158) proposes scenario-based diagnostics. RefusalBench also addresses refusal behavior. The specific three-tier context variation (no context, weak benign, strong benign) is a clean experimental design but the broader direction of measuring context-dependent refusal calibration is already partially addressed.
